rules.storybook: [documented] yes if .storybook/ exists or a storybook package is a dependency
rules.rfc_or_adr: [reconstructed] a directory named rfc(s), adr(s) or decisions
rules.npm_exports_field: [reconstructed] root package.json has an exports field
rules.semver_tags: [documented] remote tags that are semantic versions (with or without v)
rules.token_format: [reconstructed] token-named file with CSS custom properties or DTCG $value
rules.token_css_vars: [reconstructed] count of CSS custom property declarations in token files
rules.component_dirs: [reconstructed] component folders under src/components (proxy, low validity)
rules.components_strict: [reconstructed] component folders under src/components that contain an entry file (index.* or a file named after the folder)
rules.a11y_check_files: [reconstructed] JS/TS files under 300 kB that configure or call an accessibility checker (axe-core, jest-axe, vitest-axe, pa11y, Storybook a11y addon)
